description: This file defines utility functions for synchronizing and persisting file contents, including file synchronization with fsync and JSON settings persistence within the Utils namespace.

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes a file to disk by opening it, flushing buffers, calling fsync, and closing it.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists JSON settings to a file, updating a specific key with the new JSON value, and then ensures the file is synchronized to disk.
